summary: Rocket Companies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the upsizing and pricing of a $1.5B private offering of 6.125% senior notes due 2031 and 6.500% senior notes due 2034. Proceeds will redeem Rocket Mortgage's 2.875% notes due 2026 and 5.250% notes due 2028 at par plus accrued interest, contingent on the offering's June 16, 2026 closing. This is a routine refinancing liability-management transaction, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven category triggered by this debt issuance and redemption.
